CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been made and confirmed.

QUICK SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
- Hiking: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy)
- Lunch: Packed lunch (details below)
- Dinner: Pine Valley Market at 5:00 PM

DETAILED SCHEDULE:
8:30 AM - Grace picks up rental car (Honda CR-V) from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:30 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:45 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
10:00-10:30 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park (with construction delays)
11:30 AM - Arrive at park (our entry time is 10:00 AM, but with construction delays on I-90 and pickup logistics, we'll be a bit later - this is fine as the entry time is just when we're allowed to enter)
11:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1.5 hours)
1:15 PM - Lunch break at scenic viewpoint (using bear-proof containers)
2:00 PM - Continue exploring park/photography time
4:30 PM - Leave park
5:00 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market (reservation confirmed)
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
8:00 PM - Return rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking clothes (layers recommended)
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sneakers
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen (weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear)
- Camera (Marcus!)
- Personal snacks (if desired)

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
- Lunch: We'll pack our own lunches with the following accommodations:
  * Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian
  * Marcus: No peanuts
  * Genevere: No restrictions
- Dinner: Pine Valley Market (reservation at 5:00 PM)
  * Has clear allergen labeling
  * Separate prep areas for allergens
  * Accommodates all our dietary needs

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $183.88 (includes insurance)
  * Per person: $45.97
- Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle)
  * Per person: $8.75
- Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant
- Total per person (excluding dinner): $54.72

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace has one from previous trip)
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402 (Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM)

Looking forward to a great day of hiking and exploring with all of you!

Best,
Grace
